content: 1:1-4 Bebereg igamau qob qi igoar eng bo dibentarei
In igomot igamau qob eng qob suab gumaun. Qob eng wonou qoan ir igoar eng in igub ne gor magqurt gab ne baab imbig igoun.
Igomot igamau eng init dibentra gaminei. Gab ne qob apand igub qenen bebereg igamau end in qob suab igoun. Qob eng qoan Ur nob igo ag e darab inimbigorei.
In mi magqurt gab ne irugest igumin eng an bo igar qamb aninob quraum. Igub ne in nob misir erogori big ne Tain Aib wonou wau Yisas munon inubersiau tari eng mom erogori tenori ete igorun.
In qob e gumaun eng an igari erogori qenen mismisir igorun.
See qob wonou wau eng qob ininob qamara igumin eng aninob quraum. Qenu wo munon qenenginob, itum eng wo pi et bais me igo.
In ete qamb gab eng, “qo in Yisas nob mom tenori igoun.” Ende qamb gab eng in bo qomon boru ger ebet itum end me qib igorun. Qomon boru oboun eng in gag Yisas nob tenori igoun, qamb igoun.

Wo munon qoregen end in wo nob tenori igo eng in gor wonou begen end igo qoregen qib igorun. Ende at ne munon gugum qibanamsi igumune wonou wau Yisas wonou qeru init igeramor end ininou qomon boru birogoni igo.
In ete qamb eng: in qomon boru ger ue, qamb eng, ininomi mirimot qamb igoun. Oau apand eng init me igo.
Ininou qomon boru Qenut dibes qamb ne wot oabigun eng, wo in musub ne ininou qomon boru eng wab arirama uber igoruboun.
In ete qomorun eng, “qomon boru ger me abau” qomorun eng, Qenut qetopur qamarau tari wot qamb igoun. End ne wonou qob apand eng init me igo.
